text:
I was extremely disappointed after teeth whitening service at that clinic!

First of all, nurses that assist dentists don’t speak English at all. They always call for a someone that can translate from English to Thai which is very weird.

During my teeth whitening they put a lamp into my mouth and simply left the room!!! I heard that a dentist had already started to consult another patient while my treatment wasn’t finished yet!!! Suddenly , I felt strong pain and didn’t know how to ask for help since there was nobody in the room!!! I started to make hand noise to attract their attention and staff asked me stupid questions about my feelings. I couldn’t reply in a proper way since my mouth was full of teeth whitening stuff!

Also, during my call the receptionist said that clinic has no zoom whitening and they use laser system instead of zoom, however, when we started whitening I saw zoom box with whitening tools that used for my treatment.

In addition, they took pics of my teeth before and after. However, stuff didn’t want to show me the results until I asked for them. Secondly, I didn’t give any permission for photo shoot, and they didn’t ask for it.

Worst dental dental service so far! I hope the owner of clinic will keep in touch with me asap and try to figure out.

This was a long time ago, back in September 2014. I'm not trying to make any demands, just wanted to review what I experienced.
My boyfriend used the 30 baht card (Gold Card) to get a filling. When he went, his teeth were fine, but when he came back, his teeth were chipped, as shown in the picture. I was shocked. Why didn't they fill them after grinding? The clinic said in the chat that they would check, but I'm discouraged from going. Now, he's going to a clinic near Ratchayothin. His teeth are as beautiful as ever. I told the doctor about this, but he was still confused.

(I only went to the clinic to get the filling, and the doctor insisted he didn't do it.) Neither of us has any evidence. If the clinic has video or photos, please let me know.
(Before the PSK treatment, the patient had an X-ray from Mahidol Hospital, but the film was with the hospital. At that time, his teeth were fine, just decayed, not chipped like in the picture. I was very confident.) I'm confused as to whether the Gold Card treatment resulted in this kind of service. I've read other reviews and they were excellent, so I chose this clinic based on the reviews. I'm extremely disappointed. I lost one of my benefits and got a chipped tooth back.
